scope: Explicit stronger neighborhood key-gradient arithmetic; operator measurements, no model-level quality claim.

arithmetic.query: Prior normalized weighted dQ arithmetic retained bytewise.
arithmetic.correction: t=sum_FP32(P32*(dP32-delta_actualO))/sum_FP32(P32), reconstructed during the existing query traversal.
arithmetic.key: dS_key=round_input(P32*((dP32-delta_actualO)-t)); dK products accumulate FP32, scale after accumulation.
arithmetic.storage: A separate FP32 row buffer preserves the actual rounded-output delta; the two subtractions retain the small residual.
arithmetic.extra_work: Two query row reductions and one correction buffer; no additional attention pass, GEMM or GPU launch.
arithmetic.default: Default docs/precision.md and automatic dispatch are unchanged; scheduling selectors remain explicit experiments.

references.mathematical: Native torch.float64 on identical rounded Q/K/V/dO, excluding initial input quantization error.
references.formula: Independent IEEE FP32 products/reductions and prescribed operand casts, FP64 final reference products; not a tensor-core instruction-order emulator.
references.directed: Complete small tensors, independently enumerated shifted neighborhoods.
references.timing: Sparse boundary/interior query and inverse-key owners, all heads/channels at recorded positions; not full large-tensor norms.

acceptance.mathematical: Separate output/dQ/dK/dV gates for the selected method on historical fixtures and ordinary timings. New zero/constant-dP controls target O/dK/dV while preserving and reporting prior dQ.
acceptance.formula: Prescribed-equation agreement and mathematical FP64 error remain distinct.
acceptance.performance: Predeclared aim <=5% incremental resident full-call median versus prior combined method; investigate cases >10%. No tolerance or performance goal is widened after measurement.

incremental_goal.scope: Resident full forward plus backward median versus prior combined arithmetic; shape-specific descriptive result.
